name: Kau Rakkasora ni Kaerazaru Koto
original_name: 花雨 落花空に帰らざること
source:
The main character, Ajisai (name can be changed), returns to the village of the oni for the first time after she left without notice a year ago. She was warmly welcomed by "him" and was relieved to see him.

The months of not being able to see each other fostered this madness.

[translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8854]Novel Game[/url]]
translation:
主角阿吉斋（名字可以更改）在一年前不知不觉地离开后，第一次回到了鬼村。她受到“他”的热烈欢迎，见到他也松了口气。

几个月无法见面助长了这种疯狂。

[翻译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8854]小说游戏[/url]]
